title: Circular Crosshair
description: Makes your crosshair a circle, like BLMcheat. Improves bow & melee aim from my experience.
body:
This mod replaces your vanilla or texture pack crosshair by a dynamic crosshair. It can change color when hovering over enemies, with a unique animation. 

# Settings

## Enabled
Allows you to toggle the mod on/off.

## Lerp
Gradually changes the color of the crosshair when hovering over an opponent.

## Lerp Speed (only works if lerp is on)
Speed of the animation.

## Normal Color
The color of the crosshair when not hovering over an enemy.

## Hover Color
The color when hovering over an entity.

## Size
Size of circular crosshair.
